clue.text: West Indian players with a strong all-rounder

parts.note: steel stands for toughness, as in nerves of steel, so it can stand for strong
a band is a ring, something that goes all round

explanation.surface: A cricket team from the Caribbean boasting a powerful all-rounder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'West Indian players' and 'all-rounder' both suggest cricket; the players are musicians and the all-rounder is a ring.
explanation.definitionFit: Caribbean musicians playing tuned oil drums form this kind of ensemble, originating in Trinidad.

clue.text: Meet private secretary for leaks

parts.note: to see someone is to meet them
PS is the usual abbreviation for private secretary

explanation.surface: An instruction to meet a secretary in order to discuss leaked information.
explanation.definitionFit: Both mean escapes slowly through small gaps, as liquid does, in the verb sense.

clue.text: Penguin noted by Beethoven

definitions.meaning: the largest species of penguin, from Antarctica
Beethoven's fifth piano concerto bears this nickname, so it was set down in musical notes by him

explanation.surface: A penguin that the composer Beethoven happened to observe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'noted' looks like 'observed' but means written in musical notes.
explanation.definitionFit: The biggest penguin species shares its name with the popular title of Beethoven's Piano Concerto No 5.

clue.text: Scowl when let down

definitions.meaning: to frown or look sullen, also spelt lour
to bring something down, as a flag or a bucket

explanation.surface: Someone frowns on being disappointed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'let down' suggests disappointment but means simply moved downward.
explanation.definitionFit: One spelling means to frown darkly; the same word as a verb means to bring something down.

clue.text: Highly offensive action

parts.note: an attack from high up in the sky, by bombers, is offensive in the military sense

explanation.surface: Behaviour that is extremely rude.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Highly offensive' reads as very insulting; it is an offensive launched from aircraft overhead.
explanation.definitionFit: A bombing attack by aircraft is an attacking operation carried out high above the target.

clue.text: Unusually deft clue about one involved in fraud

indicators.note: about means the rearranged letters go round the next piece
unusually says the letters of deft clue come out in an unusual order

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A cleverly crafted crossword clue is suspected of being part of a swindle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts I inside DECETFUL, the anagram of DEFT CLUE signalled by 'Unusually'.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone dishonest and given to trickery is the kind of person who engages in swindling.

clue.text: It won't be seen as a boundary

definitions.text: It won't be seen as a boundary

parts.words: It won't be seen as a boundary
parts.note: a sunken ditch or fence designed to keep livestock out without spoiling the view, so it is not visible as a border

explanation.surface: Something not regarded as a border or limit.
explanation.walkthrough: The ditch is called so supposedly because walkers exclaim on finding it; it is a feature of English country-house gardens.
explanation.definitionFit: This landscaping device is a recessed barrier that bounds a park while staying invisible from the house.

clue.text: He gets a command not to stop at sea

parts.note: taken as written
a veto forbids something, an order not to do it

explanation.surface: A man receives an order not to halt while on a voyage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not to stop' seems to be part of the command; 'stop at sea' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A nautical phrase for bringing a ship to a standstill by setting the sails against each other.

clue.text: Showed uncertainty as the tide went out

indicators.note: went out suggests the tide ebbing, but signals the letters of as the tide breaking out of order

explanation.surface: Someone dithered while the sea receded.
explanation.definitionFit: Pausing before acting out of doubt is exactly how indecision shows itself.

clue.text: Main source of strength for a nation

definitions.text: Main source of strength for a nation

parts.words: Main source of strength for a nation
parts.note: the main is the ocean, so naval might is strength drawn from the ocean

explanation.surface: The chief reason a country is strong.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Main' looks like 'chief'; it is the old word for the ocean.
explanation.definitionFit: A navy and maritime dominance give a country its military reach over the oceans.

clue.text: Rewrote a score that's lacking refinement

indicators.note: rewrote says the letters of a score are written out again in another order

explanation.surface: Someone rewrote a musical score because it was crude.
explanation.definitionFit: Vulgar, rough or unpolished behaviour or material has no finesse.

clue.text: One who takes great interest in business

definitions.text: One who takes great interest in business

parts.words: One who takes great interest in business
parts.note: interest here is money charged on a loan, and a moneylender who charges a lot takes great interest

explanation.surface: A person who is keenly attentive to commerce.
explanation.walkthrough: 'interest' means charges on a loan, not enthusiasm.
explanation.definitionFit: A moneylender charging exorbitant rates on loans takes a lot of interest from borrowers.

clue.text: Perhaps it's eaten as an aperitif

indicators.note: perhaps hints the letters could be arranged differently

parts.note: it's is it is, so its letters I, T, S all count

explanation.surface: A puzzled guess that something is eaten before a meal as an appetiser.
explanation.walkthrough: A drink is not eaten, which is the hint that 'it's eaten' is anagram fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: This sweet aniseed-flavoured liqueur is drunk before or after a meal, so it serves as an appetiser drink.

clue.text: Himalayan girl in spring

indicators.note: in means one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a spa is a mineral spring
her refers to a girl or woman

explanation.surface: A young woman from the Himalaya during springtime.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spring' suggests the season but is a mineral spring.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of a people of Nepal living high in the mountains, famous as guides on Everest expeditions.

clue.text: Workers get 27 easily

parts.note: hands are labourers, as in farmhands
the answer to 27 across means depressed, and down is another word for that

explanation.surface: Labourers become dejected without effort.
explanation.walkthrough: '27' refers to the answer at 27 across, DEPRESSED, of which DOWN is a synonym.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for winning comfortably, from a jockey who can drop his hands and still win.

clue.text: Performed in a group that's dissolute

indicators.note: in means one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a band is a group, especially of musicians
done means carried out or performed

explanation.surface: Played in a musical group that was given to wild living.
explanation.definitionFit: Shameless and wildly immoral behaviour is uninhibited and wanton.

clue.text: Fullback sorts out and warms up

indicators.note: back means the word for full is read from the end

parts.note: full means fed, as after a meal

indicators.note: out says the letters of sorts come out of order

explanation.surface: A football full-back sorts things out and does a pre-match warm-up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fullback' reads as a football position but must be split into two words, the second turning the first round.
explanation.definitionFit: Thawing frozen food brings it up from freezing temperature, so it is warming it.

clue.text: Writes one's first letters

definitions.meaning: as a verb, signs with the letters of one's names, such as on a document
as a noun, the opening letters of a name

explanation.surface: Someone writes the letters at the start of their name.
explanation.definitionFit: Signing with abbreviated name letters is a verb, and those letters themselves are the noun.

clue.text: Third mate to dawdle around? Rubbish!

indicators.note: third picks out the third letter of mate
around says the letters of dawdle get moved around

explanation.surface: A ship's third mate dawdling about, dismissed with an exclamation of contempt.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are dismissive exclamations meaning nonsense or silly talk.

clue.text: Mismanagement results in warder appearing before the magistrate

parts.note: screw is slang for a prison warder
to be up means to appear in court before a magistrate

explanation.surface: Bungling leads to a prison officer being hauled into court.
explanation.definitionFit: A botched job or blunder is informal slang for bungling something.

clue.text: Boy and girl being pretentious

parts.note: a lad is a boy
Ida is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A young couple showing off airs and graces.
explanation.definitionFit: An informal term for affectedly refined or snobbish manners or speech.

clue.text: Fresh lies and disclaimers

indicators.note: fresh says the letters of lies and are made into something new

explanation.surface: New falsehoods together with statements disowning responsibility.
explanation.definitionFit: Statements rejecting responsibility or truth are refutations, so they disclaim.

clue.text: Man's man, for example

parts.note: a man from the Isle of Man is an inhabitant of an isle

explanation.surface: A typical macho man.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Man's man' looks like a manly fellow; Man is the Isle of Man, an island in the Irish Sea.
explanation.definitionFit: An inhabitant of the Isle of Man lives on an island, so is an example of an island dweller.

clue.text: Girl, a student, put through toughening process

parts.note: Anne is a girl's name
L is a learner, as on L-plates

explanation.surface: A girl, a student, undergoes hardening training.
explanation.walkthrough: L for student comes from the L-plates that learner drivers display in Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: Heat treatment of metal or glass by heating and slow cooling strengthens it.

clue.text: Right to enter complaint in dispute

indicators.note: to enter means the first piece goes inside the second

parts.note: an ague is a fever, an illness or complaint

explanation.surface: Being entitled to lodge a grievance during a disagreement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'complaint' suggests a grievance; it is an illness.
explanation.definitionFit: To quarrel or contend over something is to have words with someone.

clue.text: A capital position to be in

definitions.note: the clue reads as 'a position to be in', describing an adverb of place

parts.note: capital comes from the Latin for head, as the top of a column is its capital

explanation.surface: An excellent place to find oneself.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' looks like the adjective 'excellent'; it is the head.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in front or leading is a favourable place in a race or contest.

clue.text: Court room is lacking animation

parts.note: to court someone is to woo them
a den is a small private room

explanation.surface: A courtroom is dull and lifeless.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Court room' reads as one place; split it into two verbs and nouns.
explanation.definitionFit: A stiff, expressionless performance is described as like a block of timber.

clue.text: Lock manufacturer?

parts.note: locks are tresses of hair, and someone producing false hairpieces makes locks

explanation.surface: A firm producing locks for doors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lock' suggests a door lock; here it is hair.
explanation.definitionFit: A craftsperson producing hairpieces, such as those worn by judges, makes artificial hair.

clue.text: Part of link needing a joint

indicators.note: Part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A chain link that requires a connecting piece.
explanation.definitionFit: The hinge between thigh and shin is one of the body's main articulations.

clue.text: Put down action restricting newspapers

indicators.note: restricting means the first piece hems in the second

parts.note: a deed is an action
the press means newspapers collectively

explanation.surface: A move to curb the newspapers is suppressed.
explanation.definitionFit: Pushed downward, as on a button, or crushed in spirit, which also means pressed lower.
